description: Returns the current question of a quiz module of the customer: the text, the options with their ids, the format of the answer, the saved answer, and the progress. Ask the customer the question, then call answer_quiz_question. The result can include notes: the text of the information screens before the question. Give the notes to the customer. This tool saves no answer, but it moves the quiz past the information screens. A result with status allocation gives items that the customer picks one by one with set_allocation. A result with status in_app is a question that the customer answers in the app, at app_url. A result with status complete means that the module is finished. For the eligibility quiz, give the customer next_step and app_url of a result with status complete or ineligible.

module_slug.description: The slug of the quiz module, for example basic-information or financial-philosophy. Use eligibility, with product, for the eligibility questions before payment.

product.description: The product line. Send it for the eligibility questions, and when the customer has more than one paid agreement.

name: get_quiz_question

items.description: The items of an allocation question. picked is false until the customer picks.

module_state.description: The state of the module for a write of the customer. open: a write saves. edit_restarts_alignment: a write saves, restarts the alignment of the couple, and can email the partner. Tell the customer this and get a yes before the write. closed: the tools refuse a write. Do not collect values. Give the customer next_step_url.

next_step_url.description: Only for a closed module: the app page that shows the next step.

title: Get the current quiz question
